text: Fir'awna añiri mbileeɓe ɓen gomɗinal maɓɓe ngal, o wi'i: "Enee, on gomɗinay mo ko adii mi duŋanaa- de on ɗum?! Pellet, ko Muusaa woni mawɗo mooɗon anndinɗo on on mbilewu ngun. Hari on fow on haldiino fii yaltinngol yimɓe [saare] Misra nden e nder mayre, kono aray ka anndon ko mi fawata on kon immorde e lepte, mami taƴu sanne koyngal mo kala e junngo makko ngun mi luutindirira hakkunde majje taƴugol koyngal ñaamal ngal wonndude e junngo nano ngon maaɗum yunnitugol, mami fetu on sanne on fow mooɗon e julle tamaro, mi accataa hay e gooto e mooɗon".
